description: Change dashboard date range to rolling: user picks a start date (persisted across sessions), end date always = today. Remove 7-day chart cap. Rename 'Total Week' to 'Total'.

userStories.title: Persist start date + rolling end date
userStories.description: As a user, I want my chosen start date remembered across sessions with the end date always being today.
acceptanceCriteria: New getDashboardStartDate(): String and setDashboardStartDate(date: String) added to UserSettingsDataSource interface and UserSettingsDataSourceImpl (key: 'dashboard_start_date'; default = todayString() minus 6 days via minusDays util)
App.kt initialDateRange uses DateRange(startDate = userSettingsDataSource.getDashboardStartDate(), endDate = todayString())
When user picks a date via DatePickerDialog, only range.startDate is used; endDate always = todayString(); picked end date from dialog ignored
setDashboardStartDate(range.startDate) persisted on every date selection — either in DashboardStateHolder.setDateRange() or in the onDateRangeSelected lambda in App.kt/DashboardWithTabs
Cold restart restores persisted start date; end date recalculated as today at runtime

userStories.title: Remove 7-day chart cap + rename Total Week
userStories.description: As a user, I want the chart and history to show all days from my start date to today with no artificial cutoff.
acceptanceCriteria: CalorieBalanceChart.kt: remove balances.takeLast(7) — chart renders all entries in the list passed to it
DashboardScreen.kt: 'Total Week' text renamed to 'Total' (search entire file for the string — may appear in SlidingWindowInsightCard call or as a hardcoded Text label)
Verify no other takeLast or size-cap exists in the history row rendering in DashboardScreen.kt; remove if found
